newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: BADMINTON-DANES TO HELP SET UP 800 S.AFRICAN CLUBS.
newsitem.headline: BADMINTON-DANES TO HELP SET UP 800 S.AFRICAN CLUBS.

text.p: Up to 800 new badminton clubs are to be established in South Africa's townships as part of a two million rand ($455,000) initiative by Denmark.
The Danish government and Danish Badminton Association will fund the massive boost to the game, the South African Badminton Union announced in Johannesburg on Monday.
"It's the greatest thing that has ever happened to us," union vice-president David Parker said.
An official of the Danish Badminton Union will be based in South Africa to help oversee the project and assist the union in its development programme to advance the game in black areas.
The project starts in March with a tour by the top-ranked Danish national team. They will play the South African national side as well as take part in development clinics in townships.
Denmark are one of the world's leading badminton nations. Olympic men's singles champion Poul-Erik Hoyer-Larsen is a Dane.
